cards.text: The Jews in Judea have been trying to kill Jesus (John 7:1), and now it's the Feast of Tabernacles (John 7:2). He came up to the feast in secret, while the crowds whispered about Him (John 7:10-12). Then, about halfway through the feast, He walks right into the temple courts and starts to TEACH. So much for secret.

cards.question: The Jews in the temple courts are amazed at Jesus' teaching. What do they want to know?

answers.text: How He got such learning without studying
Why He waited so long to come and teach
Who gave Him permission to teach right here

cards.question: Jesus answers the Jews' question about His learning. Where does He say His teaching comes from?

answers.text: From the One who sent Him
From years of reading the Scriptures

cards.text: Then Jesus says there's a way anyone can know whether His teaching is from God, or whether He speaks on His own. No diploma required.

cards.question: Jesus says someone can know whether His teaching is from God. Who does He say will know?

answers.text: Anyone who desires to do God's will
Anyone who has studied the law
Anyone who has seen His miracles

cards.question: Jesus talks about someone who speaks on his own authority. What does Jesus say that person seeks?

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "…He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is a man of truth; in Him there is no falsehood."
Jesus brings up Moses, Israel's leader long ago, who gave them the law. Then He says, "Yet not one of you keeps it."

cards.question: Jesus has just told the crowd that not one of them keeps the law of Moses. What does He ask them next?

answers.text: Why are you trying to kill Me
Why do you doubt My teaching
Why did you come to this feast

cards.question: When Jesus asks why they're trying to kill Him, the crowd admits that someone is.

cards.text: The crowd fires back, "You have a demon," and then asks, "Who is trying to kill You?" Jesus asks ONE question, and He gets back a whole COMMENT SECTION.
Jesus answers, "I did one miracle, and you are all amazed." Then He reminds them that because Moses gave them circumcision, they circumcise a boy on the Sabbath, the day of rest.

cards.question: Jesus adds a side note: circumcision didn't start with Moses but with the patriarchs.

cards.text: Now Jesus brings it home: if a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so the law of Moses won't be broken, why are they angry with Him?

cards.question: Jesus asks why the crowd is angry with Him for making the whole man ___ on the Sabbath.

cards.text: That brings Jesus to one last line for the crowd, all about HOW they've been judging.

cards.question: Jesus tells the crowd to stop judging by outward appearances and start judging ___.

cards.text: Then some people of Jerusalem start asking, "Isn't this the man they are trying to kill?" Somebody in this city did NOT get the same memo as that crowd.

cards.question: Some people of Jerusalem notice that the ones trying to kill Jesus aren't saying anything to Him.

cards.text: With Jesus speaking right out in public, the people wonder, "Have the rulers truly recognized that this is the Christ?" And then, I kid you not, they talk themselves right back out of it.

cards.question: The people of Jerusalem say they know where Jesus is from. Why does that make them doubt He's the Christ?

answers.text: No one will know where the Christ is from
The Christ will come from the line of priests
The Christ will grow up in Jerusalem

cards.text: Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cries out, "You know Me, and you know where I am from." Then He says He hasn't come on His own, and the One who sent Him is true.

cards.question: Jesus tells the crowd in the temple courts that they know the One who sent Him.

cards.text: But Jesus knows the One who sent Him, because He is from Him. So they try to seize Him.

cards.question: The people Jesus is speaking to in the temple courts try to seize Him, but no one lays a hand on Him. Why not?

answers.text: His hour had not yet come
The priests told them to wait
His disciples stood in the way

cards.question: Many in the crowd believe in Jesus. They ask whether the Christ will perform more ___ than this man.

cards.text: Then the Pharisees, a group of religious leaders, hear the crowd whispering these things about Jesus. Whispering in a crowd is like whispering in an open office: somebody ALWAYS hears it.

cards.question: Once the Pharisees hear the crowd whispering about Jesus, they team up with the chief priests, the leading priests. What do they do?

answers.text: Ask Jesus to teach them more
Order the crowd to go home

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "I am with you only a little while longer, and then I am going to the One who sent Me."

cards.question: Jesus tells the people listening that they will look for Him and find Him.
The Jews ask one another where Jesus could go that they won't find Him. What do they guess?

answers.text: To the Jews scattered among the Greeks
Back up north to the towns of Galilee
Out into the wilderness near the Jordan

cards.text: They keep asking each other what He means about looking and not finding, and about a place they cannot come. Stick around, friend, because this story isn't over.
